hunks.baseline: I had just finished circulating my qi, so I unfolded my legs from the lotus position and spoke.
hunks.sol: I had just finished circulating my qi. I unfolded my legs from the lotus position and spoke.

hunks.baseline: “What kind of relationship do you and I have?”
hunks.sol: “What kind of relationship do we have?”

hunks.baseline: “Not related by blood, but comrades who can fight back-to-back? A lord-and-vassal relationship tightly bound by affection and trust?”
hunks.sol: “Comrades in arms who may not share blood but can fight back-to-back? A lord-and-vassal relationship bound together by affection and trust?”

hunks.baseline: “Affection? Hmm. You’ve made up your mind to get beaten half to death first thing in the morning.”
hunks.sol: “Affection? Hmm. You’re determined to get beaten half to death first thing in the morning.”

hunks.baseline: “One hit, then. Surely I won’t die.”
hunks.sol: “One hit, then. Surely it won’t kill me.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin stared incredulously at Cheongpung, who was sprawled out in the corner.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin stared incredulously at Cheongpung, who lay sprawled in the corner.

hunks.baseline: “Why would he sleep here when the annex has several rooms?”
hunks.sol: “Why would he sleep here when the annex has so many rooms?”

hunks.baseline: “Leave him. These things happen. I found him asleep when I got back from the privy.”
hunks.sol: “Leave him alone. It happens. I came back from the privy and found him asleep.”

hunks.baseline: To cut to the conclusion, I had failed completely at figuring out Cheongpung’s identity.
hunks.sol: Long story short, my attempt to uncover Cheongpung’s identity had ended in complete failure.

hunks.baseline: The moment he got out of the hot spring, he had fallen asleep from exhaustion. I couldn’t bring myself to wake him, so I slept, too.
hunks.sol: The moment he emerged from the hot spring, he had fallen asleep from sheer exhaustion. I couldn’t bring myself to wake him, so I went to sleep too.

hunks.baseline: “Can you say for certain that he isn’t?”
hunks.sol: “Can you say for certain he isn’t?”

hunks.baseline: “You’re a good man in many ways, Captain, but I think you take the Murim too lightly. This is a place tangled up in complicated gratitude and grudges. If you let your guard down, you really could end up dead.”
hunks.sol: “You’re a good man in many ways, Captain, but I think you take the Murim too lightly. It’s a place tangled in complicated gratitude and grudges. Let your guard down, and you could really end up dead.”

hunks.baseline: “Isn’t he a little strange? He seems remarkably skilled for someone so young, yet he wanders around dressed like a beggar. And he isn’t even a Disciple of the Beggars’ Sect.”
hunks.sol: “Isn’t he a little strange? He seems remarkably skilled for someone so young, yet he wanders around looking like a beggar. And he isn’t even a Disciple of the Beggars’ Sect.”

hunks.baseline: “Maybe that’s just the way he’s wired.”
hunks.sol: “Maybe that’s just how he is.”

hunks.baseline: “What if all of that is just a disguise meant to lower people’s guard? If he were a trained assassin, it would be entirely possible.”
hunks.sol: “What if it’s all an act meant to lower people’s guard? A trained assassin could easily pull that off.”

hunks.baseline: But suspecting Cheongpung of being an assassin was an overreaction.
hunks.sol: Still, suspecting Cheongpung of being an assassin was an overreaction.

hunks.baseline: Mujin shook his head from side to side.
hunks.sol: Mujin shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “I’m only telling you to be careful. The gratitude and grudges of the Murim run deep and stay hidden, so no one knows when or where something might happen.”
hunks.sol: “I’m only telling you to be careful. Gratitude and grudges in the Murim run deep and stay hidden, so no one knows when or where something might happen.”

hunks.baseline: “Flies swarm around appetizing food. The more famous the name Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi becomes, the more trouble you’ll have to deal with. There are even people who show up out of nowhere and challenge you to a life-and-death duel.”
hunks.sol: “Flies swarm around appetizing food. The more famous the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi becomes, the more trouble you’ll have to deal with. Some lunatics might even show up out of nowhere and challenge you to a life-and-death duel.”

hunks.baseline: The world was a big place, and there were plenty of lunatics in it. I was surprised to hear something I had never imagined, but I was also impressed by Mujin.
hunks.sol: The world was a big place, and it was full of lunatics. I was surprised to hear about something I had never even imagined, but I was also impressed by Mujin.

hunks.baseline: “You know quite a lot. What a good boy.”
hunks.sol: “You know quite a lot. Good boy.”

hunks.baseline: As expected of a local. People in the Murim around my age had apparently seen assassins killing people and all kinds of other things.
hunks.sol: As expected of a local. People my age in the Murim had apparently seen assassins killing people and all kinds of other things.

hunks.baseline: “Does that sort of thing happen every day in the Murim? You know, you go out to the market and see martial artists getting into arguments and fighting each other?”
hunks.sol: “Does that sort of thing happen all the time in the Murim? You know, you go out to the market and see martial artists picking fights with each other?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course I read about that in books.”
hunks.sol: “Of course I read about it in books.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. There was a bookstore run by an old man in front of my house. For one nyang in iron coins, you could read books for half a shichen. That’s where I nurtured my dreams.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. There was a bookstore run by an old man in front of my house. For one nyang in iron coins, you could read for half a shichen. That’s where I nurtured my dreams.”

hunks.baseline: Mujin gazed out the window with a nostalgic look in his eyes.
hunks.sol: Mujin gazed out the window with nostalgia in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: *The Shop Assistant Becomes a Sword God, You Must Hurt to Become a Martial Artist, The Son of Murim Walks Three and a Half Rounds Around the Nine Provinces and Eight Wastes,* and so on. They were really interesting.
hunks.sol: “*The Shop Assistant Becomes a Sword God, You Must Hurt to Become a Martial Artist, The Son of Murim Walks Three and a Half Times Around the Nine Provinces and Eight Wastes*… There were all sorts of books. They were really interesting.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, so you decided to become a martial artist after reading those books.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, so those books inspired you to become a martial artist.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. I even bought and kept a few of them when the bookstore went under. Would you like to borrow them?”
hunks.sol: “Of course. I even bought a few when the bookstore went under. Would you like to borrow them?”

hunks.baseline: This wuxia-novel otaku bastard was confusing fiction with reality. I grabbed Mujin by the lapels.
hunks.sol: This wuxia-novel otaku bastard had confused fiction with reality. I grabbed Mujin by the lapels.

hunks.baseline: “Do you think novels and reality are the same? Huh? Didn’t any of the novels you read have someone getting beaten to death for running his mouth?”
hunks.sol: “Do you think novels and reality are the same? Huh? Didn’t any of those novels have someone getting beaten to death for running his mouth?”

hunks.baseline: “Right, next otaku.”
hunks.sol: “Right. Next otaku.”

hunks.baseline: Honghwa Inn stood in the center of Taiyuan. Even in Taiyuan, which was known as Shanxi’s prime real estate, it was famous for its excellent location.
hunks.sol: Honghwa Inn stood in the heart of Taiyuan. Even in Taiyuan, known as Shanxi’s most valuable territory, it was famous for its prime location.

hunks.baseline: It was only natural for the area in front of Honghwa Inn to be crowded with people, but today the crowd was unusually large.
hunks.sol: The area in front of Honghwa Inn was always crowded, but today was unusually hectic.

hunks.baseline: “There’s a carriage and soldiers… Hey, Mr. Yang, have you heard anything? Is there a war breaking out?”
hunks.sol: “There’s a carriage and soldiers… Hey, Mr. Yang, have you heard anything? Is a war breaking out?”

hunks.baseline: Amid the murmuring, a luxurious, enormous carriage drawn by six fine horses came to a stop.
hunks.sol: Amid the murmuring crowd, a massive, lavish carriage drawn by six fine horses rolled to a stop.

hunks.baseline: Then at least a hundred soldiers stood in neat ranks at the entrance to Honghwa Inn. An official dressed in his robes shouted loudly,
hunks.sol: Then nearly a hundred soldiers formed orderly ranks at the entrance to Honghwa Inn. An official dressed in formal robes shouted at the top of his lungs.

hunks.baseline: The short phrase royal command carried tremendous weight. On top of that, the thunderous cry of a hundred elite soldiers caused hushed voices to spill out from every direction.
hunks.sol: The short phrase *royal command* carried tremendous weight. Coupled with the thunderous cry of a hundred elite soldiers, it drew hushed whispers from every direction.

hunks.baseline: “I know that much, but I’m saying this because he’s never made such a commotion before.”
hunks.sol: “I know that much. I’m asking because His Highness has never made such a commotion before.”

hunks.baseline: “Well, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi has become awfully famous lately. He even wiped out those Red Wind Band bastards in place of the government troops not long ago, so he’s certainly done the Prince a great service.”
hunks.sol: “Well, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi has become awfully famous lately. Not long ago, he even wiped out those Red Wind Band bastards in place of the government troops, so he’s certainly performed a great service.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you think His Highness plans to grant him an official post… Ah, they’re coming. They’re coming!”
hunks.sol: “Do you think His Highness plans to grant him an official post… Ah, they’re coming out! They’re coming!”

hunks.baseline: The doors stood wide open. As the people summoned by the Prince appeared beneath the glaring sunlight, a wave of excitement spread through the onlookers.
hunks.sol: The doors stood wide open. As those summoned by the Prince emerged into the glaring sunlight, excitement surged through the onlookers.

hunks.baseline: “They’re wearing swords, so I suppose the others are young prodigies, too.”
hunks.sol: “They’re wearing swords, so I suppose the others are young prodigies too.”

hunks.baseline: As the people whispered, five figures emerged, each one worthy of being called a dragon or phoenix.
hunks.sol: Just as the crowd whispered, the five people who emerged were all worthy of being called dragons or phoenixes.

hunks.baseline: Among them, Jin Taekyung’s presence was head and shoulders above the rest. At the very moment admiring gazes poured toward him as he stood tall in the center—
hunks.sol: Among them, Jin Taekyung stood out like a crane among chickens. Admiring gazes poured toward him as he stood tall in the center.
Then—

hunks.baseline: Not only the onlookers but even the soldiers standing at attention stared at the fallen prodigy as though they had no idea what was going on.
hunks.sol: The onlookers and even the soldiers standing at attention stared at the fallen prodigy, baffled.

hunks.baseline: When the official cleared his throat, the fallen man’s face turned bright red.
hunks.sol: At the official’s pointed cough, the fallen man’s face turned bright red.

hunks.baseline: The young prodigy who had fallen flat on his face got back up on legs trembling like a newborn calf. The official unfurled a red silk scroll.
hunks.sol: The young prodigy pushed himself up on legs trembling like a newborn calf. The official unfurled a red silk scroll.

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. The young prodigies of Murim shall receive the royal command! I, the younger brother of the holy Son of Heaven…”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. Young prodigies of Murim, receive this royal command! I, the younger brother of the sacred Son of Heaven…”

hunks.baseline: This time, the one who collapsed was a woman.
hunks.sol: This time, a woman collapsed.

hunks.baseline: The unexpected accident made the official’s breathing turn ragged for a moment. But he was the bearer of a royal command. He couldn’t let something so trivial throw him off.
hunks.sol: The unexpected accident made the official’s breathing turn ragged. But he was the bearer of a royal command. He couldn’t allow something so trivial to throw him off.

hunks.baseline: “The command I issue to you…”
hunks.sol: “The command I bestow upon you…”

hunks.baseline: This time, even the official couldn’t escape the disaster. Perhaps he had bitten his tongue, because a cracking sound came from his mouth, followed by blood streaming down his lips.
hunks.sol: This time, even the official couldn’t escape disaster. A crunch came from his mouth as he bit his tongue, and blood streamed down his lips.

hunks.baseline: The crowd fell silent, though for a different reason than before.
hunks.sol: The crowd fell silent, though for a very different reason than before.

hunks.baseline: As the official stood there in despair, one person approached him with a confident stride and whispered,
hunks.sol: As the official stood there in despair, one man strode confidently up to him and whispered,

hunks.baseline: “Do we really have to do this outside? Why not just do it inside?”
hunks.sol: “Do we really have to do this outside? Why don’t we just do it inside?”

hunks.baseline: The official considered Taekyung’s words for a moment before answering.
hunks.sol: The official considered Taekyung’s suggestion for a moment before answering.

hunks.baseline: “…Just nod. You’ll get blood on your clothes.”
hunks.sol: “…Just nod. You’re getting blood on your clothes.”

hunks.baseline: “They’re the fresh young pillars of Murim, aren’t they? They trained so hard to become stronger that they wore themselves down and keep collapsing.”
hunks.sol: “They’re the fresh young pillars of Murim, aren’t they? They trained so hard to become stronger that they wore themselves down. That’s why they keep collapsing.”

hunks.baseline: “O-oh, no. We heard him. We were just thinking of an answer…”
hunks.sol: “O-oh, no. We heard him. We were just thinking about how to answer…”

hunks.baseline: “Th-that’s right. I was waiting for someone else to answer…”
hunks.sol: “Th-that’s right. I thought someone else would answer…”

hunks.baseline: “What was there to think about? Just tell him the truth. Isn’t that right? Hahaha.”
hunks.sol: “What is there to think about? Just tell him the truth. Isn’t that right? Hahaha.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, if they told the truth, they would get some private one-on-one time with me. The law was far away, and fists were close at hand.
hunks.sol: Of course, if they told him the truth, they would get some private one-on-one time with me. The law was far away, and fists were close at hand.

hunks.baseline: The four of them, who had no choice but to stay on the good side of the Jin Family of Taiyuan if they wanted to live in peace in Shanxi Murim, forced smiles onto their faces.
hunks.sol: If the four of them wanted to keep living peacefully in Shanxi Murim, they had no choice but to stay on the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s good side. They forced the corners of their mouths upward.

hunks.baseline: The official looked suspicious and asked another question.
hunks.sol: The official still looked doubtful as he asked another question.

hunks.baseline: “But why is one person missing? As I understand it, there should be six people, including Young Hero Jin.”
hunks.sol: “But why is one person missing? As I understand it, there should be six of you, including Young Hero Jin.”

hunks.baseline: *Because that one is in no condition to be seen as a human being.*
hunks.sol: *Because that one isn’t even in a condition to look human.*

hunks.baseline: “Last night, he got injured after a minor disagreement and still hasn’t regained consciousness.”
hunks.sol: “Last night, he was injured in a minor altercation and still hasn’t regained consciousness.”

hunks.baseline: “A disagreement? Are you saying he got into a fistfight?”
hunks.sol: “An altercation? Are you saying he got into a fistfight?”

hunks.baseline: “Something like that. In any case, his face is in such a state that he simply can’t appear in front of people.”
hunks.sol: “Something like that. In any case, his face is in such a state that he simply can’t appear before anyone.”

hunks.baseline: This felt really strange. With the culprit standing right in front of him, the official muttered something about treason, then lamented.
hunks.sol: This felt incredibly strange. With the culprit standing right in front of him, the official muttered something about treason before lamenting,

hunks.baseline: “This is a serious matter. Whatever the reason, the fact remains that he can’t attend the invitation. How furious will His Highness be when he learns of this?”
hunks.sol: “This is a serious matter. Whatever the reason, the fact remains that he cannot attend. How furious will His Highness be when he learns of this?”

hunks.baseline: “Could I perhaps explain things to him properly?”
hunks.sol: “Could I perhaps explain things to him?”

hunks.baseline: “Young Master, you don’t understand. Once His Highness takes offense, no one can stop him. The surrounding area will be turned into a wasteland for the time being.”
hunks.sol: “Young Master, you don’t understand. Once His Highness takes offense, no one can stop him. The surrounding area will be turned upside down for some time.”

hunks.baseline: “Turned into a wasteland? What do you mean by that?”
hunks.sol: “Turned upside down? What do you mean?”

hunks.baseline: “What else could I mean? First, they’ll arrest and severely punish the man who injured the Young Bureau Head of the Seongun Escort Bureau. Then, citing the terrible state of public order, dozens of officials will be forced to resign. I’ll probably be one of them.”
hunks.sol: “What else could I mean? First, they’ll arrest and severely punish the man who injured the Young Bureau Head of the Seongun Escort Bureau. Then, blaming the terrible state of public order, dozens of officials will be forced to resign. I’ll probably be one of them.”

hunks.baseline: “I have more than ten family members to feed… Sigh. I can only blame the heavens.”
hunks.sol: “I have more than ten family members to feed… Sigh. I can only curse the heavens.”

hunks.baseline: *He has a big family, too.*
hunks.sol: *He has a huge family too.*

hunks.baseline: Just when I was unable to sit still and desperately racking my brain, it happened.
hunks.sol: I was squirming in my seat and desperately racking my brain when—

hunks.baseline: A carefree yawn completely out of place in the atmosphere.
hunks.sol: A carefree yawn, completely at odds with the mood.

hunks.baseline: My eyes lit up when I saw someone coming downstairs with a long stretch.
hunks.sol: My eyes lit up when I saw someone descending the stairs with a long stretch.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, how about we do this?”
hunks.sol: “Hey, how about this?”

hunks.baseline: “If we bring along an even more impressive young prodigy, there won’t be a problem. Right?”
hunks.sol: “If we bring an even more impressive young prodigy, there won’t be a problem. Right?”

hunks.baseline: “I can’t be certain, but that’s probably true. His Highness wouldn’t complain if you found someone even more outstanding.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t be certain, but probably not. His Highness wouldn’t complain if you found someone even more outstanding.”

hunks.baseline: He was a young prodigy who was no less than a Peak master.
hunks.sol: He was a young prodigy who was a full-fledged Peak master.
